judgments.reason: The support_span cites a serum IgG4 of 36.0 mg/dL, which falls within the normal reference range (4.5–117 mg/dL). Elevated IgG4 (typically >135 mg/dL) is the hallmark serologic feature supporting Type 1 AIP (IgG4-related). A normal IgG4 level does not clinically support the Type 1 subtype designation; it actually argues against it.
